podcast.body: This song became an FM staple on album rock radio by the end of 1977, joining other deep cuts from "Rumours" that became fan favorites. "on album rock radio almost every song on the album became an FM staple from the chain to second hand news to Gold Dust Woman."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.body: Fleetwood Mac's song "Gold Dust Woman" was covered by Hole and featured as a hit on *The Crow: City of Angels* soundtrack in 1996. The soundtrack went on to sell about 3 million copies. "The hit was a cover of the Fleetwood Maxx on Gold Dust Woman by Whole."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
